messages.content: The packing team tracks bolts in two trays. Tray A began with 34 bolts, sent 9 to a client, then received 4 back. Tray B began with 22 bolts and sent 7 to a client. Five bolts from tray A must stay in reserve. How many bolts can ship now from both trays together? Return only a JSON object with integer fields a_available, b_available, total.
